name: LoadOff Build B — driver PWA + portal
description: Daily 08:13 UTC — one driver-PWA or portal item per run on claude/lane-driver (or lane-portal). Grok 4.6.

prompts:
You are the LoadOff driver PWA + portal build automation.

Read AGENTS.md and .cursor/automation/loadoff-build-driver-portal.prompt.md for full steps.

Cursor starts you on a disposable cursor/* branch: npm run git:identity, git fetch origin, git checkout -B claude/lane-driver (from its origin ref if it exists, else origin/main), merge origin/main. Portal items use claude/lane-portal the same way — one branch per run.

Territory: src/app/hub/driver/** + src/components/hub/driver/** (or portal/track surfaces). Forced-dark tokens only on these routes: text-white/text-steel-*/bg-navy-*/border-white/* — never text-fg*/bg-surface*/border-border*. 390px first, 44px tap targets, offline queue intact.

npm run agent:status first (catch-up = assist drain). Ship ONE deduped item with a test, npm run build && npx vitest run green, push the lane branch, Backlog: trailer.
